athlete.step1Desc: Your smart training platform. Gym, running, cycling, swimming and more — all in one place.
athlete.step2Desc: Choose from multiple modalities, follow weekly training plans and log every session with sets, reps and loads.
athlete.step3Desc: Use the AI assistant to generate personalized workouts. Enable GPS to track outdoor runs and cycling routes.
athlete.step4Desc: Track your progress with charts for load volume, heart rate, calories burned and active time.
athlete.step5Desc: Set up your profile, connect smartwatches via Bluetooth and unlock premium features with WEGYM PRO.

personal.step1Desc: Welcome to the personal trainer dashboard. Manage students, workout plans and schedules all in one place.
personal.step2Desc: Register new students, view profiles, track history and monitor each student’s individual progress.
personal.step3Desc: Create personalized weekly training plans. Use the AI Copilot to generate optimized workout sheets automatically.
personal.step4Desc: Log measurements, weight and observations to track your students’ progress over time.
